objective: Run the KU2D Acquisition Consolidation & Readiness Overnight Campaign v1 as one long repository-grounded queue: consolidate proven acquisition knowledge across domains, build reusable pattern and failure libraries, reprioritize gaps, harden deterministic contracts/regressions, and produce a platform readiness report for future locked-source batch acquisition, without any new live source request or authority promotion.
instructions: Use Branch Handoff Protocol v1 mechanically. Close the current source queue before switching, then create/switch to codex/ku2d-acquisition-consolidation-readiness-v1 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at exact merge commit 9a4761cbc975194a56053d711357c933aa3117e4 and initialize the target queue as sole authority. Use a fresh handoff id. Preserve completed history and fail closed on any handoff inconsistency.

This is one overnight campaign and one Prompt/Result chain. Do not return control to Assistant between internal phases. Use internal checkpoints/commits as useful, but continue through all phases. If one phase is blocked by missing evidence or a human gate, record a precise blocker/deferred_human_gate and continue to later independent phases. Stop the whole campaign only for repository-integrity risk, coordination ambiguity, failing protocol invariants that cannot be repaired mechanically, or destructive action risk.

GLOBAL EVIDENCE RULE: evidence before conclusion. Every retained finding/pattern/gap/readiness claim must cite durable repository evidence. If evidence is insufficient, classify it candidate, unresolved, insufficient_evidence, or no_existing_code_fits/novel_pattern_candidate rather than guessing or forcing an existing taxonomy. Preserve Code != Theme != Descriptor != Interpretation and technique != environment. Do not reinterpret historical outcomes retroactively.

PHASE 1 — Coffee closure baseline. Use the accepted KU2D-R-000031 / V31 Coffee consolidation as baseline: Nana is evidence-recovery-complete for this phase; Roots remains the sole open Coffee evidence gap; Coffee is complete-with-open-gap. Do not rerun Coffee or alter authority state. Ensure later cross-domain artifacts accurately preserve this disposition.

PHASE 2 — Cross-domain evidence consolidation. Inventory merged/durable evidence across at least Supermarket (Lotus's, Big C, Makro, Tops, Gourmet Market), Retail/JIB, Marketplace boundaries and Lazada/Shopee, YouTube/Q-Diving, Coffee Roots/Nana, LINE/OTA/Coffee/Q-Diving parked candidate evidence where durable reviewed evidence exists, and major environment/access-boundary episodes. Normalize only supported facts into a common evidence map such as source/domain/surface/technique/environment/observed_evidence/outcome/limitations/transferability/confidence/provenance. Do not mutate parked refs and do not promote candidate-only evidence.

PHASE 3 — Acquisition Pattern Library v1. Derive reusable patterns only where supported by durable evidence. At minimum evaluate: sitemap-to-canonical-detail discovery, structured/SSR product detail catalogs, rendered product detail, app-bundle discovery, official API metadata acquisition, source-detail normalization, search-vs-detail price comparison, official campaign surface, and explicit environment/Edge boundary handling. For each pattern record prerequisites, evidence threshold, applicability, non-applicability, failure modes, provenance requirements, repeatability expectations, Deep Audit expectations, known source examples, and transferability confidence. Explicitly separate source-specific workaround from reusable technique and environment from technique.

PHASE 4 — Failure & Boundary Pattern Library v1. Consolidate observed failure/boundary types including cloud access boundary, explicit challenge vs screening-only false positive, semantic matcher limitation, insufficient retained evidence, source discovery failure, extraction failure, rendering dependency, product-vs-variant ambiguity, price-role ambiguity, displayed-order-not-demand, blocked-access-not-extraction-failure, request-retention/diagnostic gaps, wrong-host/canonical ambiguity, and any novel supported cases. For each pattern define minimum evidence needed before conclusion, safe stop behavior, what must not be inferred, and whether recovery is offline, bounded-live, environment-specific, or human-adjudicated.

PHASE 5 — Gap Register and Recovery Backlog refresh. Reconcile KG001-KG008, evidence-recovery priorities, Coffee outcomes, parked candidate reviews, and later gaps into one current storage-neutral backlog. Score/prioritize each gap using value, unresolved uncertainty, expected reuse/generalization, recovery cost, evidence availability, and need for live/human authority. Classify each as close_now_offline, next_bounded_live_candidate, defer, human_adjudication, obsolete/superseded, or monitor. Do not execute any live or human-gated recovery in this campaign.

PHASE 6 — Regression & contract hardening sweep. Inspect merged acquisition code/contracts/tests for deterministic, low-risk problems such as duplicate logic, stale fixtures, inconsistent names/exit classifications, source-specific logic leaking into generic layers, weak assertions, portability/newline assumptions, missing provenance assertions, or tests that can silently false-green. You MAY implement only small deterministic backward-compatible hardening with explicit regression tests and no semantic broadening beyond already accepted evidence. Do not perform a large refactor, architecture rewrite, API behavior change, source technique change, or live validation. Record larger issues as architectural findings/backlog items instead.

PHASE 7 — KU2D Acquisition Readiness Report v1. Produce a durable report and machine-readable readiness artifact answering: what data/surface types KU2D can acquire now; which techniques are proven/candidate/source-specific; strongest domains; current source tiers for future batch acquisition; unresolved risks; which components are ready to become reusable acquisition-engine primitives; which remain experiments; readiness for one-way KU2D → KU2A Dataset Intake; top five next actions; and low-value/redundant work not recommended. Define Tier A Locked & Repeatable, Tier B Locked with Caveat, Tier C Not Batch Safe using evidence-based criteria. Do not claim a source Tier A unless its technique/evidence/provenance/repeatability/audit state supports it.

Prepare a future Locked-Source Batch Acquisition Campaign v1 manifest TEMPLATE only, not execution. The template should define per-source technique lock, environment, request/pagination budgets, expected record range or bounded objective, provenance contract, repeatability/Deep Audit gates, drift/anomaly metrics, stop conditions, exit classification, and forbidden automatic escalation. Populate source readiness recommendations only from evidence; do not perform any external request.

For any future batch design, enforce: a locked source must never autonomously switch acquisition technique/environment during the batch. If the locked method fails, stop that source and log a boundary/drift result instead of exploring browser/Edge/login/auth/bypass/private API/proxy or another technique. Environment escalation always remains separately governed.

QUALITY FOUNDATION: preserve observation vs interpretation; Code/Theme/Descriptor distinctions; negative/deviant cases; alternative explanations; source limitations; and verification against durable raw/sanitized evidence where retained. Do not let a summary artifact overwrite contradictory evidence. Add no_existing_code_fits and novel_pattern_candidate where taxonomy lock-in would otherwise occur.

AUTHORITY/SAFETY: zero live/external source requests in this campaign; no browser/Edge/network acquisition; no authentication/login/challenge handling/bypass/circumvention/private API/proxy; no Candidate Learning Evidence or higher-authority promotion; no Reviewed Corpus/Core Knowledge/Human Confirmation/Ground Truth mutation unless merely reading existing merged records; no parked-ref merge/close/delete; no branch cleanup; no production/store/scheduler action; no ML training/inference/export; no Survey/DoE/SEM work; no main mutation; no integration merge by Codex.

Repository operations: use one target campaign branch and preferably one campaign PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform. Commit meaningful checkpoints. Keep the PR Draft while substantive campaign work is incomplete, then perform deterministic full-corpus validation, JSON/YAML parse, Python compilation, relevant regressions, git diff --check, and exact-head CI. Perform safe mechanical Draft→Ready if all campaign acceptance checks pass; if connector ready transition hits the known Repository.fullDatabaseId limitation, the previously established minimal authenticated GraphQL workaround may be used without logging/persisting credentials.
